data.title: 迦摩 · 魔王沙发的慵懒午后
data.description: 她的领域一角，成年形态的她横卧在华丽沙发上，单手撑头、另一只手指尖转着花之箭；身边散落着零食与靠垫，「魔王的工作」看起来就是彻底地躺着。
data.action: 她的领域一角，成年形态的她横卧在华丽沙发上，单手撑头、另一只手指尖转着花之箭
data.promptProse: Adult Kama lounges on the sofa in an opaque plum sweatshirt and full-length charcoal trousers, one elbow supported by a cushion while she turns a flower-tipped arrow in her other hand. White hair spreads beside a lazy red-eyed glance at the unopened snack packet. The medium view includes the low table and overlapping cushions. Afternoon window light brightens arrow petals and her face, leaving soft folds shaded where her arm meets the cushion.
